description: Above 500 items the chunk export is sharded: `/chunks-01.jsonl` holds the lines of the first 500 items in slug order, `/chunks-02.jsonl` the rest, no item is split across shards, and `/chunks.jsonl` becomes the JCS-canonical manifest of AGSC-06-31. Derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine. The manifest has three members and no others: `bundle_version`, the content version of AGSC-04-25 the build derived; `lines_total`, the number of chunk lines across every shard; and `shards`, the shard paths in shard order. JCS (AGSC-04-05) orders member names code point by code point, so `bundle_version` comes first (`b` before `l` before `s`), and JCS emits no space and no line break; AGSC-06-26's one trailing LF terminates the file. The input is 501 items of one line each, so `lines_total` is 501 and the split at 500 items puts item `i-0501` alone in the second shard: 500 lines in `/chunks-01.jsonl`, 1 in `/chunks-02.jsonl`. A chunk LINE carries none of the manifest's members, its member set being closed by AGSC-06-29.
